# Enum

## Summary
Base-realm field. Lives at `https://cardstack.com/base/enum` (default export). Field factory, not a FieldDef: `enumField(StringField, { options })` returns a constrained subclass with a dropdown edit UI. The module also exports `enumConfig`/`normalizeEnumOptions`/`enumAllowedValues`. This realm's MatrixConcept lane/state fields are built with it.

## Usage
```ts
import enumField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/enum';
```

Example: `const LaneField = enumField(StringField, { options: ['Fields & Types', …] })`
